<!-- Generated by `make catalog-export` from the comments in the warehouse. Edit catalog/tables.yaml, then run `make catalog-comments catalog-export`. -->

# Warehouse tables

- checks.ingest_stats: Rows read from each source file and rows kept, one row each time a month of a source was loaded into silver. Use for how many rows a load read, kept or dropped. It is append-only: take the newest row per service and month.
- checks.results: Results of the pipeline's data quality checks (pass, warn or fail), one row each time a check ran on a table and partition. Use for the health of the data. It is append-only, so take the newest row per check, target and partition for the current state.
- expectations.drivers: For scored expectations, how much each slice (a service, an operator, a zone relation) contributes to the gap between observed and expected, one row per expectation, dimension and slice per scoring run. It has no timestamp: join to expectations.verdicts on run_id to find the latest run.
- expectations.verdicts: The outcome of scoring each written-down expectation (held, violated, pending and so on) with the observed value and expected range, one row per expectation per scoring run. Append-only: use the run with the latest scored_at for the current state.
- gold.baselines: What a normal day looks like for a metric: the 10th, 50th and 90th percentile of the same weekday over the previous 8 weeks, one row per metric, slice and date. Use to judge whether a day was unusual. It does not hold what actually happened; get that from gold.daily_entries or gold.daily_trip_slices.
- gold.daily_entries: Daily count of vehicles entering the Congestion Relief Zone, one row per date, vehicle class, crossing point and time period, from 2025-01-05. The first choice for entries per day, week, month or year. For hours or 10-minute blocks use silver.crz_entries.
- gold.daily_trip_slices: Daily count of taxi and ride-hail trips broken down by service, operator (Uber or Lyft), pickup hour, and whether the trip started or ended inside the toll zone. Use for those breakdowns; for plain totals by service gold.daily_trips is smaller.
- gold.daily_trips: Daily count of taxi and ride-hail trips, one row per pickup date and service (yellow or fhvhv). The first choice for trips per day, month or year by service. It has no operator, hour or zone; for those use gold.daily_trip_slices.
- reference.cbd_zones: The 265 TLC taxi zones with name, borough, and whether each lies inside the congestion toll zone (38 do). Use to name a zone id from silver.trips or to list zones. Daily counts by inside or outside the zone are already in gold.daily_trip_slices.
- reference.holidays: US federal and New York State public holidays from 2023 to 2027, one row per date with the holiday's name. Use to mark or exclude holidays; join on the date.
- silver.crz_entries: Vehicle entries into the Congestion Relief Zone from the MTA, one row per 10-minute block, vehicle class and crossing point, about 6.9 million rows from 2025-01-05. Use only for questions finer than a day (hours, 10-minute blocks) or about detection_region. For daily totals use gold.daily_entries.
- silver.trips: Every yellow taxi and ride-hail (Uber, Lyft) trip, one row per trip, about 1.07 billion rows. Use only when a question needs single trips, exact times, dropoff, zones, miles or the fee amount. For counts per day use gold.daily_trips or gold.daily_trip_slices.
